execution_message.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: KCK-03B2 side model-sheet correction, ONE PNG candidate only. Image 1 is the failed SIDE edit target; Image 2 is the Owner-approved identity/rendering reference ONLY, not the output camera pose. Preserve exact Soft Handmade 2.5D paper grain, warm brown outline, palette, large-head/short-body proportions and genuine alpha. Entire full body on square canvas with clear transparent margin; no text, collage, duplicate character, floor, cast shadow, new props, white matte or watermark. Screen light stays upper left. Keep visible eye anatomy and upper-left primary/lower-right small glints. Do NOT return Image 2 front camera; keep side nose pointing SCREEN LEFT. Correct Image 1 BODY CAMERA: head, torso, shoulder/hip and feet must ALL be orthographic anatomical LEFT SIDE profile facing SCREEN LEFT. The failed target has profile head but a broad FRONT-FACING belly; rotate the TORSO so the belly is on the FORWARD EDGE of the body, seen only as a narrow cream edge/side sliver on the LEFT outline. Do not show a full cream oval with two complete horizontal lines. The original TWO curved belly lines still exist on the anatomical FRONT surface but are naturally mostly OCCLUDED from strict side; show only short line ends if visible on the narrow cream edge. This is natural view occlusion, not deletion/redesign. One near-side foot visible in full; far foot naturally overlaps/occludes in strict projection, no splayed front-facing feet. Near anatomical LEFT hand still holds original yellow-orange magnifying glass with pale blue lens in front at screen LEFT; far right chest hand may occlude, never swap hands or add a new arm. Keep existing profile head/one warm brown eye/cheek/mouth, dorsal yellow spikes and rear tail, head/body size, original standing pose and all identity colors. Preserve two eye glints; primary centroid about x=.35,y=.28 in visible eye, secondary smaller lower right. Do not turn head/torso toward camera or show a broad front belly.
